title: Cody’s Arduino launcher
author: codyhsu
status: Source analysis and proposed breakout; not a verified build

parts.name: Controller
parts.note: UNO was the earlier version; Mega is used for IR and sound.

parts.name: Motor driver
parts.spec: L293D / Adafruit Motor Shield v1 compatible
parts.note: AFMotor.h interface; not the I²C v2 shield. Verify clone wiring.

parts.name: Launch motors
parts.spec: DC motor; model and voltage unspecified
parts.note: Measure stall current before selecting a driver or supply.

parts.name: Launch tires
parts.spec: Tamiya 94325 large-diameter sponge tire / wheel set
parts.note: Source names a limited-edition Mini 4WD set; fit and availability unverified.

parts.name: Feeder motor
parts.note: Drives the rotary ball-metering disk; no rated voltage given.

parts.name: Aiming servo
parts.note: Moves the hinge linkage. Verify travel and load before attaching horn.

parts.name: Ball detector
parts.note: Senses a ball in the feed channel; not a speed sensor.

parts.name: Local controls
parts.note: Feed interval, launch speed, oscillation range.

parts.name: Remote control
parts.spec: HX1838 receiver module + NEC IR remote
parts.note: Check receiver-module pin order; bare receiver and module differ.

parts.name: Sound
parts.note: Proposed PCB uses an external passive buzzer driver module instead.

parts.name: Regulator
parts.note: Set output before connection. Input must exceed required output.

parts.name: Battery cells
parts.note: Unverified capacity claim. Pack topology and protection are not established.

parts.name: Battery holder
parts.note: Series/parallel wiring not specified; do not infer a charger connection.

parts.name: Charger
parts.note: Listed for individual 3.7 V nominal cells; not a documented 2S charger.

parts.name: Prototype board
parts.note: Replace with the proposed breakout after bench verification.

parts.name: Hopper
parts.note: Feeds the rotary disk under gravity.

parts.name: Structure
parts.note: Stand, cross feet and hopper cradle; dimensions not published.

parts.name: Pivot
parts.note: Servo linkage steers the launcher assembly.

parts.name: Feed tube
parts.note: Guides balls toward the wheels; fit must be measured.

parts.name: Control breakout
parts.note: J1–J7, C1 100 nF, C2 10 µF; unrouted, no fabrication outputs.

parts.name: Buzzer interface
parts.spec: 5 V passive buzzer driver module, active-high signal
parts.note: Input must accept 5 V logic and tone pulses; choose module before routing.

parts.name: Bench power
parts.spec: Current-limited motor supply + regulated 5 V servo supply
parts.note: Mega powered by USB for initial tests; grounds common, positive rails separate.

parts.name: Protection and assembly
parts.spec: Fuse, disconnect, wire, connectors, guards, fasteners
parts.note: Size protection and wiring from measured current; quantities depend on build.

connections.note: Common signal ground; motor/servo returns go directly to their supply.
Feeds pots, receiver and low-current buzzer module only; never servo or motors.
J2: 1 GND · 2 wiper · 3 +5V_LOGIC; B10K feed interval pot.
J3: 1 GND · 2 wiper · 3 +5V_LOGIC; B10K launch-speed pot.
J4: 1 GND · 2 wiper · 3 +5V_LOGIC; B10K sweep-range pot.
J5.1 GND to switch COM; J5.2 to NO. INPUT_PULLUP; debounce in firmware.
J6: 1 GND · 2 +5V_LOGIC · 3 receiver OUT. Verify module connector order.
J7: 1 GND · 2 +5V_LOGIC · 3 passive driver IN. No bare magnetic buzzer on GPIO.
Servo + to external regulated 5 V, servo − to supply ground. Do not join external +5 V to shield +5 V.
Proposed dedicated channel; confirm forward direction at low duty.
Proposed dedicated channel; opposite mechanical rotation, both surfaces propel ball outward.
Proposed dedicated channel; M4 unused. Verify each motor against driver current limits.

connections.endpoint: External supply → fuse → disconnect → shield EXT_PWR
connections.note: Remove shield power jumper for USB logic + external motor power. Voltage depends on measured motor ratings.
